pages.name: Povitrulia
pages.text: A flying serpent with no arms or legs, but with wings.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: It flies the sky and, once it sees you, begins to $(thing)spit fire$(). It has no venom and keeps its distance, circling you.$(br2)Hating snakes will not help here: this one flies.

pages.title: What to do
pages.text: $(li)$(#7952A6)Ranged weapons$() reach it while it circles.$(li)$(#7952A6)Put out fire$() and do not stand in the open.$(li)Cover from the fire helps while it circles.
